messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: outgoing pages -> P1 incident INC-20260305-17. High error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (>= 25% 5m). Auto-escalation to oncall @alex_oncall. Links: https://ops.redwood.example/incidents/INC-20260305-17 :warning:

Alex (oncall): I'm on it — joining. Gathering logs now. Anyone see any recent deploys to us-west-2?

Jamal (SRE): No user-triggered deploys in the last 2 hours from the deploy bot. I'm tailing the model-serving logs and router metrics. Seeing spikes in 503s and a lot of downstream KV cache misses.

Alex (oncall): Ok. Maria, heads up — this may impact a handful of customers on Dedicated. Can you triage CS notifications?

Maria (CS): Yep. Can you confirm impact window and which customers are affected (IDs)? I can craft a short message for statuspage and targeted emails. Kevin from BrightApps is in the thread (cc) — Kevin, are you seeing errors?

Kevin (Customer): We're getting 500s on production requests since ~08:06 PDT. Our app shows degraded search suggestions. We've routed to our engineers. Please keep us posted.

Jamal (SRE): Quick snapshot: first anomaly at 1765008960 (08:04 PDT), error rate climbed to 30% at 08:06. Root cause hypothesis: a KV cache compaction job overlapped with heavy traffic, causing transient eviction storm and increased model backend latency -> router timeouts. Confirming whether autoscaler misfired.

Alex (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) scale up fallback model pool (+20%), 2) pause KV compaction job, 3) roll back last autoscaler agent shard change if needed. I'll run step 1 now.

incident-bot: Deploy job queued: scale-model-pool us-west-2 +20% (job id scale-7791).

Jamal (SRE): Pool scale accepted, watching metrics. Rolling average latency down from 800ms -> 220ms after pool scale. Error rate trending down to 6% in the last 2m. I'm pausing the compaction job now.

Alex (oncall): Good. Maria, draft status page and customer message below then we'll send targeted to the impacted customers once we confirm stable for 15m.

Maria (CS): Draft status page update (proposal):

```
Status: Partial outage - Degraded generation in US-WEST-2
Started: 2026-03-05 08:04 PDT
Current status: Mitigated (requests returning to normal)
Impact: Affected customers may have experienced 5xx errors or increased latency for text generation requests.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when fully resolved.
More info: We scaled additional model capacity and paused a backend compaction job. Our engineering team is investigating the root cause and will provide a detailed RCA within 72 hours.
```

Alex (oncall): Edit: replace "Mitigated" with "Monitoring" until 15m of stable metrics.

Maria (CS): Updated. Customer email draft for impacted customers (short):

"Hi Kevin / BrightApps team,

We observed elevated error rates and increased latency on our text generation endpoint (us-west-2) starting ~08:04 PDT today. We scaled additional capacity and paused a backend maintenance job; at the moment requests are returning to normal. We're continuing to monitor. We will follow up with a concise RCA and preventative actions within 72 hours. If you see any residual impact please reply and we'll prioritize.

Apologies for the disruption,
Maria, Customer Success on behalf of Redwood Inference"

Kevin (Customer): That's perfect — thanks. Please let us know when it's resolved so we can remove mitigations on our side.

Jamal (SRE): Timeline so far (for RCA notes):
* 08:04 PDT (1765008960) - Anomaly detection triggered by router error spike.
* 08:05 - 08:06 - Error rate rose to ~30%; alerts fired.
* 08:07 - 08:10 - Oncall paged and initial triage.
* 08:11 - 08:13 - Scaled model pool (scale-7791) and paused compaction job.
* 08:17 - Error rate dropped below 10%; latency improving.

Alex (oncall): Current status: monitoring. Error rate ~4% over last 5m. I'll keep a 15m watch. If stable we'll post final status update and send targeted emails.

Rachel (PM): For the post-incident customer follow-up (RCA), can we make sure to include: timeline, customer impact (which endpoints, percent requests affected, any data loss = none), immediate mitigations, root cause hypothesis, long-term fixes and owners, and expected ETA for fixes. Also want a short blameless summary for execs.

Maria (CS): Noted. I'll assemble a customer-facing RCA summary after engineering confirms root cause. Draft idea for the RCA opening line: "We experienced a transient service degradation in us-west-2 that affected text generation requests for some customers. We mitigated impact by scaling capacity and pausing a backend maintenance task; no customer data was lost."

Jamal (SRE): Preliminary RCA hypothesis: compaction job overlap + incomplete autoscaler warmup -> eviction storm on KV cache -> model backends timed out -> router 502/504s. Could be a scheduler race when compaction triggered during mid-traffic. We'll confirm with more traces.

Alex (oncall): Action items:
- Jamal: Full trace collection + confirm root cause & repro steps (ETA 24h).
- Maria: Send targeted email to affected customers with monitoring note now, and draft RCA for review (ETA 3h).
- Rachel: Prepare exec one-pager summary for SLT (ETA 6h).
- Alex: Follow up on autoscaler agent config and create temporary guard to avoid compaction during high traffic windows (ETA 48h).

incident-bot: NOTE: paging handoff reminder. If oncall is going to hand off before stable, please document status + runbook entry.

Alex (oncall): I'll hand off after 15m stable watch. Jamal — you'll be backup. Maria, please send the customer note now.

Maria (CS): Sent targeted email to affected accounts (BrightApps, NovaSearch, and 3 others). Email thread ids: 7891,7892. Copy of message in sent items.

Kevin (Customer): Received email and monitoring shows improvement. Thank you. Please include any prevention plan in the RCA.

Alex (oncall): Final note for thread: we will post a status update as "Resolved" after 15m stable and follow up with a formal RCA to customers within 72 hours. Assigning owners in internal ticket INC-20260305-17.

Jamal (SRE): Creating RCA ticket and linking traces now. I'll update this thread with root cause confirmation when ready.

Maria (CS): Thanks team. Closing communication loop with customers now. I'll post the final status page update once Jamal confirms root cause. :thumbsup:

[thread ended]
__note: This file is a synthetic Slack thread representing incident paging, mitigation, handoff, status page and customer follow-up coordination.
